title: Add a missing budget
statementMd:
Set the budget of the movie titled `The Room Next Door` to 15 and then list movies with a budget above 100.

Expected columns: `title`, `budget_millions`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
UPDATE movies SET budget_millions = 15 WHERE title = 'The Room Next Door'; SELECT title, budget_millions FROM movies WHERE budget_millions > 100;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
